title: Strings that YAML 1.1 reads as booleans
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as strings, but YAML 1.1 reads each as a boolean, and many existing readers still do (libyaml and PyYAML, Psych and SnakeYAML among them). As strings they are quoted. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.
